helpText: Welcome to Habs Bingo! A very UNOFFICIAL version of the Habs Bingo game from the official Canadiens app from a few years ago, because we missed it.
Before the game, load up this site and get your first bingo card! If you don't like your options, you can click the "New Card?" button and generate a new board with fresh options.

Refreshing the page will remember where you left off (as long as you're not in private/incognito mode), but your cards will expire 18 hours after they were generated, so take your screenshots of your wins before the next game to keep 'em!
The page will also generate a new card for you if its been updated since the last time you visited the page.
During the game, click on the tiles as events happen, as we're a completely manual process here. If you get a bingo, you'll get a notification! You can continue playing to get more bingos afterwards.
The gear icon will take you to a settings menu. Feel free to explore those options if they interest you.
You can also enable "Silly Mode", which will make the game a bit harder and probably more confusing to understand if you're not part of the target audience for this app (my family).
Good luck, have fun, and go Habs go!
